study_metadata.design: Single mentalist and matched-control fMRI case comparison
study_metadata.controls: Matched comparison participant under similar task conditions.
study_metadata.analysis: 1.5 T fMRI; exact statistical thresholds and multiplicity correction not verified from abstract.
study_metadata.reported_findings: Authors report right parahippocampal activation in mentalist and left inferior frontal activation in control.
limitations: Activation differences do not establish a communication mechanism.
Full methods retrieval blocked; behavioral scoring and information shielding not independently appraised.

study_metadata.design: Systematic review with qualitative methodological evaluation
study_metadata.analysis: Separates explicit behavioral-response paradigms from implicit neurophysiology-only paradigms. EEG accounts for 91%; fMRI 5%, as reported in abstract.
study_metadata.reported_findings: Authors identify small samples, weak multiplicity control, analytical flexibility, heterogeneous findings and sparse replication; definitive conclusions remain premature.
limitations: 129 reviewed studies are not newly ingested independent evidence.
Search protocol, risk-of-bias details and study-level estimates not inspected.

study_metadata.design: Opinion and methodological criticism of six earlier neuroimaging studies
study_metadata.analysis: Discusses cue counterbalancing, trial-order randomization, information shielding and small samples.
study_metadata.reported_findings: Authors judge the available corpus insufficient for firm conclusions about psi.
limitations: Criticisms are attributed commentary, not newly tested defects.
No new cohort or systematic-review protocol.

study_metadata.design: Narrative overview of distant-healing intention research
study_metadata.analysis: Separates experimental effects from efficacy as a healing therapy.
study_metadata.reported_findings: Authors state that observed experimental effects do not yet establish confidence in clinical efficacy.
limitations: Full-page retrieval blocked; synthesis methods and study-level data not inspected.
Article licence does not grant dataset reuse rights.

study_metadata.design: Experimental fMRI comparison of psi and non-psi stimuli
study_metadata.controls: Non-psi stimulus contrast; stimulus-arousal differences provide an activation comparator.
study_metadata.analysis: Exact model, thresholds, statistical sensitivity and multiplicity control not verified.
study_metadata.reported_findings: Authors report no neural-response distinction between psi and non-psi stimuli; arousal differences produced expected activation differences.
limitations: Null finding concerns this design; does not establish universal absence.
Full methods and participant count remain unverified.
